name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2020-06-16.4.2) "*That the committee does not insist on its amendments to which the House has disagreed.*" In other words, the majority was keen to insist on their amendments. This means that the bill with the Senate amendments will once again return to the House of Representatives for their consideration.
